name: box jump drop 2 foot land
description: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.
instructions: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.
